description:
Job Description:- 
 At least 4 years of experience in software design, development and release. 
 Well versed with agile development methodologies. 
 Experience in Data Ingestion, Streaming and Big Data technologies. 
 Excellent communication and stakeholder management 
 Ability to work with distributed teams. 
 Exposure to Data Warehousing , Reporting and related technologies would be an added advantage. 
 Apache Flume, NiFi, Kafka, Spark or Storm . 
 Good Analytical skills 
 A high degree of initiative and flexibility 
 
 Basic Qualifications :- 
 Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education. 
 At least 4 years of experience within the Information Technologies. 
 
 Note:- 
 This is a   Full-Time & Permanent job opportunity   for you. 
 Only   US Citizen ,   Green Card Holder ,   GC-EAD ,   H4-EAD & L2-EAD   can apply. 
 No   OPT-EAD, H1B & TN candidates   please. 
 Please mention your   Visa Status   in your   email   or   resume .
